title: Beatblock
tagline: Introduction: A New Era of Voting with the dApp Vote System In leveraging the benefits of blockchain technology, NFTs, and zero- knowledge proofs, the dApp vote system introduces an innovative and secure way to conduct transparent yet private voting for artist performances
description:
A voting system for Music event : Problems Addressed:
Fraud Prevention: NFT-backed tickets reduce the potential for ticket fraud and counterfeit tickets, ensuring that only legitimate ticket holders can participate in the vote.
Double Voting Prevention: With each NFT ticket holder getting a single vote, the risk of double voting or manipulation of votes.
Privacy Concerns: Using zkps ensures that voters’ preferences remain private while still allowing the system to verify the eligibility of their vote.
Community Engagement: The dApp enhances engagement by involving attendees in the voting process, fostering a sense of community participation.
